title: Pennsylvania Health System Allegedly Recorded Patient Visits with Abridge AI Scribe Without Informed Consent
summary: A Pennsylvania patient alleges that Allegheny Health Network and its parent, Highmark Health, used Abridge’s AI medical scribe to record her visits and send the audio to Abridge without adequately disclosing either step. She says learning how the tool worked caused emotional distress. The claim of commercial model training on her visit data is pleaded on information and belief.
